verdict.rationale: Factory documents delegating tasks and reviewing/merging from the App or terminal (factory-docs-1), running from terminal/editor via Droid CLI (factory-docs-2), cloud session sync making sessions available from any browser (factory-docs-19), and an API to manage a session's lifecycle/messages (factory-docs-13, factory-docs-18), which together imply cross-surface continuation of a task. However, none of the docs explicitly describe interrupting/taking over a mid-flight agent task and redirecting it live across surfaces. Missing for 10: explicit 'takeover'/interrupt-and-redirect workflow documentation, hands-on or independent confirmation that a session started in one surface can be actively redirected from another.
